Timer.name: Firstaidstatustimer
Timer.script:
-- Paste the full script into the existing 500 ms timer. if not snd.toggles.active then return end local char = gmcp and gmcp.Char local vitals = char and char.Vitals local status = char and char.Status if not vitals or not status then return end
-- Retry commands at most once per second while awaiting confirmation. -- The existing capture triggers remain authoritative for confirmed state. snd.statusTimerPending = snd.statusTimerPending or {} local function sendSetting(key, command, needed) local pending = snd.statusTimerPending if not needed then pending[key] = nil return end local now = getEpoch() local last = pending[key] if not last or last.command ~= command or now - last.time >= 1 then send(command, false) pending[key] = {command = command, time = now} end end
local function removeFrom(list, value) local index = table.index_of(list, value) if index then table.remove(list, index) end end
if status.race == "Aetherial" and snd.endgamedef == "" then snd.endgamedef = "safeguard" snd.endgamehealth = "pulse" end
if vitals.equilibrium == "1" then if snd.have_aff("disrupted") then snd.aff_remove("disrupted") end end
local have_pipe = vitals.pipe == "1" local have_pill = vitals.herb == "1" local have_poultice = vitals.salve == "1" local have_sip = vitals.elixir == "1"
if (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness","slough"},1) and snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"paralysis","paresis"},1) and (have_pipe and have_pill)) or ((snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"accursed","hellsight"},2) or snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"weariness","slickness"},2)) and have_pipe and have_pill) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness","anorexia"},2) and (have_pipe and have_poultice)) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"paralysis","paresis"},1) and snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness","slough","anorexia"},2) and (have_pipe and have_pill and have_poultice)) or ((snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"paralysis","paresis"},1) and snd.have_aff("anorexia") and (have_pill and have_poultice))) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"lameness","paralysis","anorexia"},3) and (have_pill and have_poultice)) or (((snd.have_aff("aeon") and have_pipe) or (snd.have_aff("anorexia") and not snd.have_def("speed") and have_sip)) and snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"clumsiness","lethargy","hypochondria"},1)) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"confusion","paralysis"},2) and have_pill) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness", "anorexia", "impatience"}, 2) and have_pill and (have_pipe or have_poultice)) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness", "arrhythmia"}, 2) and (have_pipe and have_pill)) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness", "destroyed_throat"}, 2) and have_poultice) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"slickness", "anorexia", "paralysis"}, 3) and (have_pipe and have_pill and have_poultice)) or (snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"impatience", "sepsis"}, 2) and (have_pipe and have_pill and have_poultice)) then snd.need_fitness = true else snd.need_fitness = false end
if snd.check_dome() and snd.toggles.dome and table.size(snd.people_hitting_me) > 1 and not snd.toggles.bashing then if snd.aff_tally() >= 5 or (tonumber(vitals.hp) and tonumber(vitals.maxhp) and tonumber(vitals.maxhp) > 0 and tonumber(vitals.hp) / tonumber(vitals.maxhp) * 100 < 70) then snd.need_dome = true else snd.need_dome = false end else snd.need_dome = false end
local function discardQueuedPrestore(limb) local prefix = "PRESTORE " .. limb .. " " for i = #snd.setting_priority, 1, -1 do if snd.setting_priority[i]:sub(1, #prefix):upper() == prefix:upper() then table.remove(snd.setting_priority, i) end end end
local function handoffPrestore(limb, thresholdKey, priorityKey) local previous = snd.prestoreOverride if previous and previous.limb == limb then return end
if previous then discardQueuedPrestore(previous.limb) sendSetting( "prestore " .. previous.limb, string.format( "FIRSTAID PRIORITY PRESTORE %s %d%% %d", previous.limb, previous.threshold, previous.priority ), true ) snd.prestoreOverride = nil end
if limb then local track = snd.firstaidcuretrack local threshold = tonumber(track[thresholdKey]) local priority = tonumber(track[priorityKey])
if threshold and threshold > 1 and priority then snd.prestoreOverride = { limb = limb, threshold = threshold, priority = priority, } end end end
if snd.firstaid then snd.masterprerestore() --if have_poultice then if snd.have_aff("hypothermia") and (tonumber(snd.my_limb_damage.torso) or 0) > 1 then snd.canprerestorenow = true handoffPrestore("torso", "pretorso", "torso") discardQueuedPrestore("torso") sendSetting( "prestore torso", "FIRSTAID PRIORITY PRESTORE torso 1% 11", tonumber(snd.firstaidcuretrack.torso) ~= 11 or tonumber(snd.firstaidcuretrack.pretorso) ~= 1 ) else -- Keep the original selection order; only one limb is chosen per tick. local selected for _, entry in ipairs({ {"head", "head", "prehead"}, {"right_leg", "rightleg", "prerightleg"}, {"left_arm", "leftarm", "preleftarm"}, {"right_arm", "rightarm", "prerightarm"}, {"torso", "torso", "pretorso"}, {"left_leg", "leftleg", "preleftleg"}, }) do if snd.have_aff("pre_restore_" .. entry[1]) then selected = entry break end end snd.canprerestorenow = selected ~= nil if selected then local limb = selected[1]:gsub("_", " ") handoffPrestore(limb, selected[3], selected[2]) discardQueuedPrestore(limb) sendSetting("prestore " .. limb, "FIRSTAID PRIORITY PRESTORE " .. limb .. " 1% 24", tonumber(snd.firstaidcuretrack[selected[2]]) ~= 24 or tonumber(snd.firstaidcuretrack[selected[3]]) ~= 1) else handoffPrestore(nil) end end snd.firstaidchangecure = false -- retain the original queue-cycle behavior if #snd.setting_priority > 0 then enableTimer("reset check") end --end
local health, maxhealth = tonumber(vitals.hp), tonumber(vitals.maxhp) local mana, maxmana = tonumber(vitals.mp), tonumber(vitals.maxmp) if snd.not_aff("blackout") then local previous = tonumber(snd.lasthealth) if health and previous then local change = health - previous if math.abs(change) >= 100 then local colour = change < 0 and "red" or "cyan" cecho("<" .. colour .. ">[" .. string.format("%+d", change) .. "]") end end snd.esthealth, snd.estmana = vitals.hp, vitals.mp snd.lasthealth, snd.lastmana = vitals.hp, vitals.mp end if health and maxhealth and maxhealth > 0 then snd.percenthealth = roundDown(health / maxhealth * 100, 0) end if mana and maxmana and maxmana > 0 then snd.percentmana = roundDown(mana / maxmana * 100, 0) end
snd.hiddencheckfunc()
snd.firstaidresetlistnone() snd.firstaidassist() snd.elevatecheck()
local suppressFocusForGloom = snd.cureset == "sciomancer" and snd.have_aff("gloom") and not ( snd.not_aff("impatience") and ( snd.checksomeSelfAffs({"blight", "infestation", "dread"}, 3) or snd.checksomeSelfAffs(snd.cures.tree, 2) ) )
local wantFocus = not snd.disablefocus and not suppressFocusForGloom sendSetting( "focus", "firstaid use focus " .. (wantFocus and "on" or "off"), wantFocus ~= snd.focusing ) sendSetting("focus", "firstaid use focus " .. (wantFocus and "on" or "off"), (wantFocus and not snd.focusing) or (not wantFocus and snd.focusing)) -- Paralysis must not cause stormtouched to alternate on/off each tick. local wantStormtouched = snd.cureset == "shaman" and snd.not_aff("paralysis") sendSetting("stormtouched", "firstaid stormtouched " .. (wantStormtouched and "on" or "off"), (wantStormtouched and not snd.stormtouching) or (not wantStormtouched and snd.stormtouching))
local wantNyctophobia = snd.have_aff("nyctophobia") and have_pill and tonumber(snd.firstaidcuretrack.nyctophobia) ~= 3 sendSetting("nyctophobia", "firstaid priority nyctophobia 3", wantNyctophobia) if wantNyctophobia then snd.firstaidchangecure = true end if snd.ordered_list[1] and snd.not_aff(snd.ordered_list[1]) then table.remove(snd.ordered_list, 1) end snd.statusTimerDebug = snd.statusTimerDebug or {} for _, entry in ipairs({ {"elevatedaff", "Current elevated affs"}, {"ordered_list", "Affs needing elevating"}, {"firstaidtobepredicted", "Affs needing predicting"}, {"firstaidpredict", "Affs predicted"}, }) do local key, label = entry[1], entry[2] local value = table.concat(snd[key], ", ") if value ~= snd.statusTimerDebug[key] then if value ~= "" then cecho("\n<blue>" .. label .. ": " .. value) end snd.statusTimerDebug[key] = value end end
if snd.class == "Monk" then snd.stance = vitals.stance end
if not table.contains(snd.firstaidpredict, "recklessness") and not table.contains(snd.firstaidtobepredicted, "recklessness") and snd.hidden_afflictions >= 3 then if snd.cureset ~= "none" then if vitals.hp == vitals.maxhp and vitals.mp == vitals.maxmp and snd.not_aff("recklessness") then removeFrom(snd.firstaidtobepredicted, "recklessness") table.insert(snd.firstaidtobepredicted, "recklessness") end end else if vitals.hp ~= vitals.maxhp and vitals.mp ~= vitals.maxmp then if table.contains(snd.firstaidpredict, "recklessness") then removeFrom(snd.firstaidpredict, "recklessness") end if table.contains(snd.firstaidtobepredicted, "recklessness") then removeFrom(snd.firstaidtobepredicted, "recklessness") end end end
if vitals.prone == "1" and snd.not_entangled() and snd.not_aff("paralysis") then snd.aff_have("prone") else snd.aff_remove("prone") end for _, name in ipairs({"fangbarrier", "cloak"}) do local value = vitals[name] local defence = snd.defenses["def_" .. name] if defence and value == "0" and defence.state == "deffed" then snd.def_remove(name) elseif defence and value == "1" and defence.state ~= "deffed" then snd.def_gain(name) end end if vitals.maxhp ~= vitals.hp and snd.have_aff("recklessness") then snd.aff_remove("recklessness") end if snd.defenses.def_insomnia.state ~= "deffed" then if hasSkill("Insomnia") then sendSetting("insomnia", "insomnia", true) end end if not snd.firstaiddefence then if snd.defenses.def_speed.state ~= "deffed" and vitals.elixir == "1" and not snd.speedcoming then send("drink speed") snd.speedcoming = true elseif snd.defenses.def_levitation.state ~= "deffed" and vitals.elixir == "1" then sendSetting("levitation", "drink levitation", true) elseif snd.defenses.def_instawake.state ~= "deffed" and vitals.herb == "1" then sendSetting("instawake", "eat stimulant", true) end end
if snd.have_aff("asleep") and not snd.waking and snd.not_aff("stun") and snd.not_aff("unconsciousness") then send("wake") snd.waking = true if waketimer_timer then killTimer(waketimer_timer) end waketimer_timer = tempTimer(3.0,[[snd.waking = false]]) end
if snd.not_aff("stun") and snd.not_aff("unconsciousness") and snd.not_aff("asleep") then if snd.have_aff("fallen") and snd.restand and vitals.equilibrium == "1" then if snd.not_aff("paralysis") and (snd.not_aff("right_leg_broken") or snd.not_aff("left_leg_broken")) and snd.not_aff("right_leg_crippled") and snd.not_aff("left_leg_crippled") and snd.not_aff("frozen") then if snd.class == "Monk" and not snd.kipup then snd.send("qeb kipup") snd.kipup = true tempTimer(5,[[snd.kipup = false]]) end snd.send("qeb stand") snd.restand = false if restandtimer_timer then killTimer(restandtimer_timer) end restandtimer_timer = tempTimer(2,[[snd.restand = true]]) end end end
if snd.clottime and tonumber(vitals.bleeding) > 30 and not (snd.have_aff("haemophilia") or snd.have_aff("stun")) then snd.clotcheck() snd.clottime = false if reclottimer_timer then killTimer(reclottimer_timer) end reclottimer_timer = tempTimer(1,[[snd.clottime = true]]) end if tonumber(vitals.bleeding) > 1500 and snd.cureset == "indorani" and snd.firstadder then sendSetting("adder", "firstaid adder off", true) elseif tonumber(vitals.bleeding) < 1500 and snd.cureset == "indorani" and not snd.firstadder then sendSetting("adder", "firstaid adder 3", true) end end
snd.parry() snd.avoidancecheck() snd.core()
if table.size(snd.people_hitting_me) == 0 and not snd.toggles.attacking then snd.cureset = "none" end

Timer.name: reset check
Timer.script:
if #snd.setting_priority > 0 then reset_cures = true local x = #snd.setting_priority while x > 0 and snd.firstaid_go do local setting = table.remove(snd.setting_priority, x) local normalized = setting:lower() local limb = normalized:match("^prestore (.-) %d+%% %d+$") local pending = limb and snd.statusTimerPending and snd.statusTimerPending["prestore " .. limb]
local duplicate = pending and pending.command:lower() == "firstaid priority " .. normalized and getEpoch() - pending.time < 1
if not duplicate then snd.firstaid_go = false snd.send("firstaid priority " .. setting) --, false end
x = x - 1 end tempTimer(.1, [[snd.firstaid_go = true]]) else reset_cures = false snd.firstaid_go = false disableTimer("reset check") end

Timer.name: Sneezy
Timer.script:
if not snd.spoken then local commands = {"A sneeze", "Snez", "Sneeze!"} local which = math.random(#commands)
snd.send("wt "..commands[which]) end snd.sneeze = false disableTimer("Sneezy")
